title: Playboy Magazine December 1985 Barbi Benton Gala Christmas Bill Cosby
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal storage and handling wear; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1985 - Gala Christmas Issue. Cover price $4.00.

Features:
- Barbi Benton Is Back! Lookin' Better Than Ever
- Playboy Interview: genial genius Bill Cosby
- Special Report: Why Drug Enforcement Can't Work
- Our guide to the best dating bars in America
- Great Holiday Stuff: David Letterman, Brooke Shields, Huey Lewis, Dan Jenkins, Lillian Ross, Paul Theroux, Donald Westlake, Cynthia Heimel, Bruce Jay Friedman
- Sex Stars of 1985
- Andrew Tobias on how to read a tax shelter
